name: Cinazepam
summary: Nalobrazepam (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name), also known as cinazepam or BD-798 and sold under the brand name Levana in Ukraine, is an atypical benzodiazepine derivative.

pharmacology.text: Cinazepam has an order of magnitude lower affinity for the benzodiazepine receptor of the GABAA complex relative to other well-known hypnotic benzodiazepines such as nitrazepam and phenazepam.

uses.text: Nalobrazepam (INN), also known as cinazepam or BD-798 and sold under the brand name Levana in Ukraine, is an atypical benzodiazepine derivative.

summaryZh: 西那西泮（英語：Cinazepam，代號：BD-798），商品名為Levana，是一種非典型的苯二氮䓬類衍生物。它產生顯著的催眠、鎮靜和抗焦慮作用，同時具有最小的肌肉鬆弛副作用。
summaryZhHans: 西那西泮（英语：Cinazepam，代号：BD-798），商品名为Levana，是一种非典型的苯二氮䓬类衍生物。它产生显着的催眠、镇静和抗焦虑作用，同时具有最小的肌肉松弛副作用。
